sonnet.problem: The story card says the pig has the divided hoof but is only 'halfway there,' with a lid and 'NOTHING inside.' That tells the baker the pig is missing the other half of the test, which is the answer to the choice card right after it (card 11: it does not chew the cud). The card 11 question also restates the hoof, so the setup leaves little to work out.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
